549:     Default(Route<E>),

554: impl<S, E> Fallback<S, E>
555: where
556:     S: Clone,
557: {
558:     fn merge(self, other: Self) -> Option<Self> {
559:         match (self, other) {
560:             (Self::Default(_), pick @ Self::Default(_)) => Some(pick),
561:             (Self::Default(_), pick) | (pick, Self::Default(_)) => Some(pick),
562:             _ => None,
563:         }
564:     }
565: 
566:     fn map<F, E2>(self, f: F) -> Fallback<S, E2>
567:     where
568:         S: 'static,
569:         E: 'static,
570:         F: FnOnce(Route<E>) -> Route<E2> + Clone + Send + 'static,
571:         E2: 'static,
572:     {
573:         match self {
574:             Self::Default(route) => Fallback::Default(f(route)),
575:             Self::Service(route) => Fallback::Service(f(route)),
576:             Self::BoxedHandler(handler) => Fallback::BoxedHandler(handler.map(f)),
577:         }
578:     }

580:     fn with_state<S2>(self, state: S) -> Fallback<S2, E> {
581:         match self {
582:             Fallback::Default(route) => Fallback::Default(route),
583:             Fallback::Service(route) => Fallback::Service(route),
584:             Fallback::BoxedHandler(handler) => Fallback::Service(handler.into_route(state)),
585:         }
586:     }

590:             Fallback::Default(route) | Fallback::Service(route) => {
591:                 RouteFuture::from_future(route.oneshot_inner(req))
592:             }
593:             Fallback::BoxedHandler(handler) => {
594:                 let mut route = handler.clone().into_route(state);
595:                 RouteFuture::from_future(route.oneshot_inner(req))
596:             }
